layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market after a major hardware wallet hack — no safe swing trades right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful state right now, with the Fear and Greed Index sitting at 27 out of 100. A major security breach hit Coldcard hardware wallets, draining $89 million and causing thousands of Bitcoin holders to panic-move coins to exchanges. Most altcoins are in downtrends with bearish chart structures, and Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.3%, which means money is flowing away from smaller coins. None of the swing trade candidates offer a compelling risk-reward setup today.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and preserve capital. The market is fearful and dominated by negative news — this is not the time to chase trades. Wait for the dust to settle from the Coldcard hack and for clearer technical setups to emerge.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 27 is close to the 25 threshold where rule #3 says the outlook is genuinely ambiguous and HOLD is safest. RSI is my most reliable signal (71% win rate), and the two oversold coins (BONK at 29, TRUMP at 27) both show bearish engulfing or bearish chart structures with chart bias scores of -1.4 and -0.7 respectively — RSI oversold without confirming bullish reversal patterns is a trap in a fear-driven market. KAITO's RSI of 87 is a strong sell signal per my RSI track record, not a buy. High BTC dominance (56.3%) adds a -1.0 headwind to all altcoin trades. The Coldcard exploit news is a genuine negative catalyst creating real selling pressure as holders move BTC to exchanges. With no funding rate data available and no confirming DeFi TVL trends (all showing 0% 7d change), there simply aren't enough quality signals aligning to justify risking capital.
